modalities.evidence: brain oxygenation was monitored using functional near-infrared spectroscopy

output.population: Twenty-two athletes (mean age: 33.3 ± 10.8 years) and twenty non-athletes (mean age: 28.9 ± 9.0 years)
output.summary: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy of prefrontal, sensory motor and posterior parietal oxygenation in endurance athletes and non-athletes undergoing high-intensity interval training and pressure pain tests.
